summary: This bill requires the Attorney General and the Director of the FBI to designate the Chinese Communist Party as a transnational organized crime group and a top international criminal organization, respectively, and amends federal law to facilitate its prosecution for racketeering activities by extending the statute of limitations and removing certain legal immunities.

scores.thoughts: The bill mentions fentanyl trafficking from China as one of the reasons for designating the Chinese Communist Party as a transnational organized crime group. This indicates a focus on stricter enforcement against drug trafficking, specifically fentanyl.

The core of this bill is to designate the Chinese Communist Party as a transnational organized crime group and amend U.S. law to facilitate its prosecution under racketeering statutes. This is a strong move towards stricter justice and stronger policing against a foreign entity perceived as criminal.
